subject: DR exercise: audit trace, video markers and RPO timestamps requested
messages:
From: Maya Sundar <security@forgebank.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Request: DR exercise audit trace + video markers (ForgeBank SIG)

Hi Karthik / Evelyn,

Thanks again for walking us through the SIG last week. As a follow-up from our control owners, we need consolidated artifacts from Redwood's April DR exercise to complete the ForgeBank SIG appendix:

- Precise RTO/RPO measurement timestamps (start/end of failover, time to restore for primary services).
- Activity logs (ops commands, who executed, timestamps) covering 2027-04-01 02:00 UTC through 2027-04-02 08:00 UTC.
- Video markers: short timestamps (hh:mm:ss) within the DR exercise recording that show the key events (failover initiation, DNS change, service validations).
- Attendee list with roles (L1/L2/L3) and any post-mortem sign-off.

Can you upload these artifacts to the Drive folder below or share a secure bundle? We prefer segregated files (CSV logs + a small text file with the video markers) rather than a single giant recording. If any pieces are redacted for security, please provide an index of redactions.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1DR_EXERCISE_FORGEBANK_2027
SIG question reference: see attached (forge_sig_initial_request.pdf)

We need the package by EOD Tuesday (2027-05-11) to stay on the compliance review cadence. If you expect delays, please flag now so we can coordinate an extension.

Best,
Maya Sundar
Senior Security Analyst
ForgeBank

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Sundar <security@forgebank.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 11:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request: DR exercise audit trace + video markers (ForgeBank SIG)

Thanks Maya — putting Ben/ops on this. Quick plan:

- Ben will extract the activity log slice and generate a CSV with command-level timestamps and actor IDs.
- We will run the video segmentation script to produce a markers manifest (timestamps for: failover start, DHCP/DNS switchover, primary check OK, dependent service verification) and a short set of 30–60s clips for each key marker.
- Evelyn: can you confirm post-mortem sign-off exists and share the attendee list?

Ben — target deliverables and formats requested by ForgeBank:
  * CSV: columns [timestamp_utc, node, action, actor_email]
  * RPO/RTO measurements: simple CSV with service_name,start_utc,restore_utc,elapsed_seconds
  * markers: plain text manifest (one hh:mm:ss per line) + manifest checksum

I will upload a stub note to the Drive folder once we have the first artifacts. If anything needs redaction (for e.g., internal IPs), flag it in the manifest.

Karthik
Director, Compliance & Trust
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Maya Sundar <security@forgebank.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 15:30:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request: DR exercise audit trace + video markers (ForgeBank SIG)

Karthik / team — attaching the initial export and links. Items included here (attached/uploaded):

Attachments:
- dr-activity-log-20270401-20270402.csv (activity log slice, 14k rows)
- rpo-metrics-summary.csv (service-level RPO/RTO numbers)
- dr-video-segments-manifest.txt (markers for recording id 20270401-DR-SESSION)

Drive uploads:
- 30s clip: https://drive.google.com/file/d/CLIP_FAILOVER_START
- 45s clip: https://drive.google.com/file/d/CLIP_DNS_SWITCHOVER

Notes:
- RPO/RTO numbers are measured against the warm cache restore and full service validation. For service "inference-api-prod" we show: start 2027-04-01T02:43:12Z, restore 2027-04-01T02:48:47Z (elapsed 335s).
- Activity log includes anonymized hostnames (we replaced full instance IDs with host-xxxx) — no redactions to timestamps or actor emails.
- Video manifest is plain text with line items like "00:03:27 - Failover command executed by ops@redwood.ai". Full recording kept on internal retention; small clip exports are linked above.

Next steps: I can run the exec_trace script to produce a JSON trace if ForgeBank prefers structured events (takes ~2 hours). Will also add a short chain-of-custody note to the Drive folder (dr-package-upload-note.txt).

—Ben
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Sundar <security@forgebank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 16:40:00 -0000
Subject: DR exercise artifacts uploaded: ForgeBank SIG package 

Maya — thanks for the patience. We uploaded the requested package to the Drive folder and summarized contents below so you can hand to your control owners: 

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1DR_EXERCISE_FORGEBANK_2027
Uploaded items:
- dr-activity-log-20270401-20270402.csv (CSV, 14k rows)
- rpo-metrics-summary.csv (CSV: service_name,start_utc,restore_utc,elapsed_seconds)
- dr-video-segments-manifest.txt (text markers with short descriptions and clip file IDs)
- dr-package-upload-note.txt (chain-of-custody + checksum list)

Quick highlights:
- inference-api-prod RTO observed: 335s (start 2027-04-01T02:43:12Z, restore 2027-04-01T02:48:47Z). RPO: ~0s for cache warming, 60s for session rehydration where applicable (see CSV).
- Attendees: Ben Carter (SRE), Evelyn Hart (Head of Ops), Karthik Iyer (Compliance). Post-mortem sign-off timestamp: 2027-04-03T14:10:00Z.
- Redactions: none beyond hostname tokenization (host-xxxx). Full exec trace JSON can be produced on request.

If your reviewers want the full exec_trace JSON or additional clips, Ben can produce it; we expect a ~2 hour turnaround. Let us know if you want us to redact anything further for distribution.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Compliance & Trust
Redwood Inference
